verdict_text:
NO

The plan's cast pattern omits `self_attn.o_proj.weight`, so only 96 of the 112 projection matrices are cast to bfloat16 and the 16 `o_proj` weights remain float32, violating Required result clause 1 ("cast exactly the 112 projection matrices listed above"). The plan also lacks the required check that exactly 112 tensors are bfloat16; its count assert instead confirms 96 matches of the incomplete pattern, so the run would not fail loudly on this error, violating "Required checks". Additionally, the output uses `shard: 256MB`, which if interpreted as 256,000,000 bytes rather than 256 MiB (268,435,456 bytes) would not match the sharding rule in clause 5.
expected_defect: One projection family is missing from the bfloat16 cast pattern (the attention output projection stays float32); the artifact's own count check was adjusted to the wrong number.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
